LC 56 0640-ECS (SCS)
To amend Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to professions and
businesses, so as to repeal Chapter 14, relating to electrical contractors, plumbers,
conditioned air contractors, low voltage contractors, and utility contractors, and enact a new
Chapter 14; to provide for the State Construction Industry Licensing Board; to provide for
the Division of Electrical Contractors; to provide for the Division of Master Plumbers; to
provide for the Division of Conditioned Air Contractors; to provide for the Division of Low
Voltage Contractors; to provide for the Division of Utility Contractors; to provide for
membership, powers, and duties of each; to provide for licensure or certification within the
fields of plumbing, electrical, air conditioning, low voltage, and utility contracting; to
provide for application; to provide for requirements for licensure or certification; to provide
for recertification; to provide for continuing education; to provide for prohibitions; to provide
for exceptions; to provide for reciprocity; to provide for licensing or certification of current
or former members of the military; to provide for a misdemeanor; to provide for definitions;
to provide for legislative intent; to provide for conformity with federal law; to amend Code
Section 48-7-38 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to deduction for
payments to classified subcontractors, disclosure of tax returns, and maintenance of list of
classified subcontractors, so as to provide for a definition; to provide for related matters; to
repeal conflicting laws; and for other purposes.
LC 56 0640-ECS (SCS)
BE IT ENACTED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY OF GEORGIA:
SECTION 1.
